headword: {姿勢矯正|しせいきょうせい}

definitions.explanation: The practice or process of correcting one's body posture, whether through exercises, devices, chiropractic treatment, or conscious habit changes.

examples.japanese: {姿勢矯正|しせいきょうせい}⟦ベルト→ベルト：01508_beruto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a posture correction belt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{整体|せいたい}→整体：27407_seitai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{姿勢矯正|しせいきょうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my posture corrected at a chiropractic clinic.

examples.japanese: ⟦デスク→デスク：23405_desuku⟧ワーク⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{猫背|ねこぜ}→猫背：10133_nekoze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{日頃|ひごろ}→日頃：07284_higoro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{姿勢矯正|しせいきょうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{意識|いしき}する→意識する：17974_ishikisuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: People who do a lot of desk work tend to develop a hunched back, so it's important to be mindful of posture correction in daily life.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧ (posture) and ⟦{矯正|きょうせい}→矯正：14784_kyousei⟧ (correction; straightening). With the rise of desk jobs and smartphone use, {姿勢矯正|しせいきょうせい} has become a popular health topic in Japan. Products like posture belts, cushions, and ⟦{整体|せいたい}→整体：27407_seitai⟧ (chiropractic/bodywork) treatments are widely marketed.
